parameters.query:
INSERT INTO municipio (geocode, nome, mesorregiao, geom, centroid)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3,
        ST_Multi(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON($4), 4326)),
        ST_Centroid(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON($4), 4326)))
ON CONFLICT (geocode) DO UPDATE
SET nome = EXCLUDED.nome,
    mesorregiao = EXCLUDED.mesorregiao,
    geom = EXCLUDED.geom,
    centroid = EXCLUDED.centroid;
